name: What's the difference between LED and fluorescent lighting for laundry rooms?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between LED and fluorescent lighting for laundry rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: LED (Light Emitting Diode) and fluorescent lighting both offer energy efficiency but differ in performance. LEDs are generally more energy-efficient, have a significantly longer lifespan (often tens of thousands of hours), and produce instant full brightness without flickering. They also offer more precise control over color temperature and dimming. Fluorescent lights are less expensive initially but burn out faster, contain mercury, and can hum or flicker. For laundry rooms, LEDs are now the preferred choice due to their superior efficiency, longevity, and quality of light.
acceptedAnswer.description: LEDs are more energy-efficient, last longer, and provide instant, flicker-free light with better control than fluorescent bulbs. LEDs are generally preferred.
